text: So the month of practices aimed at harmonizing the seventh chakra has come to an end. I hope that you have practiced regularly and have noticed that you began to perceive what is happening more deeply, became calmer, happier. Perhaps even in terms of health something has changed for the better… And now I suggest that you do not lose the wave and continue the practices! For many years you have strengthened a certain way of thinking, values, habits, psychological clichés, and now you have only begun to free yourself from all this, step by step discovering who you really are. Continuing movement in this direction will, of course, give you deeper results.
